attr.title: RustTune
attr.desc: Native Rust + Slint audio-only YouTube Music player for RG35XX H / ROCKNIX.
attr.desc_md: An audio-only, gamepad-first YouTube Music player built with Rust + Slint. Features search, Up Next radio, synced lyrics, offline M4A caching, dynamic album accent themes, Pocket Lock mode, and a local Web UI secured by a 6-digit pairing PIN.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Connect to Wi-Fi to stream, import playlists, or cache tracks offline.
attr.inst_md: Ready to run. Connect to Wi-Fi to stream or cache tracks offline. Open the local Web UI URL and 6-digit PIN shown in Find or Settings from your phone or PC.
